_comment: Implementation-discipline corpus: positives are write/fix/refactor/review-code intents; negatives are sibling domains — change narration (git-toolkit), repo health (oss-repository-conventions), markdown stewardship (docs-steward). 'write a commit message' must not activate on the 'write' verb alone.
positive: implement this task in python with clean code
add a small feature and refactor the surrounding python code
fix this bash code and review the error handling
refactor this python code for a cleaner design
clean up this messy code before the next task
review this code against our coding principles and design rules
write clean python code for this task
review this typescript code for design discipline
this rust code needs a fix — the design is over-abstracted
implement the fix for this rust task
write the bash code for this task and review it
fixing the review findings in this python code
negative: write a commit message for my staged changes
squash and reorder my branch's commits before review
draft the pull request description for this branch
what house files should a healthy open-source repo have?
scaffold a code of conduct and security policy
check our markdown for lint violations
normalize heading styles across the docs folder
is my pull request ready to merge?
audit this repository against OSS best practices
run the docs through prettier and report drift
set up dependabot and pin the CI actions
